top_signals.title: Hua Hong, Weichai Power to Join Hong Kong’s Stock Benchmark
top_signals.summary: Hang Seng Indexes Co. is adding Hua Hong Grace Semiconductor Ltd. and Weichai Power Co. to Hong Kong’s equity benchmark, the index compiler said following its quarterly review.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Wall Street's existential crisis over perpetual futures — the 24/7 security on steroids — just got urgent
top_signals.summary: Perpetual futures, or perps, are shaking up exchanges as investors seek continuous access to trading.

top_signals.title: Australia’s Beetaloo Shale Basin Is About to Start Pumping Gas
top_signals.summary: First gas from Australia’s Beetaloo shale basin is scheduled to start flowing next month, with initial production of 37 million cu m, Reuters has reported, noting hopes that the country could replicate the U.S. shale gas success story. The Beetaloo basin is located in the Northern Territory and is estimated to hold some 500 trillion cu ft of gas. It has been compared to the giant Marcellus shale play in the United States.
